meta.title: Ultimate routing system
meta.status: Merit pick is implemented behind ROUTER_ON, default off. HOLD merge until Nick Yes on the merge.

live.true: Seat this plan allows when the edge when-clause is true. Not a heartbeat from this turn.
live.false: Forbidden, or a design that is not built.

meta.neverTraverse: Edges whose when starts with NEVER are kill-lines. Do not animate them as taken.

failoverTokens.wait: Hold for the named gate. Do not skip it.

nodes.label: Nick ask
nodes.why: Every new ask enters here. The job carries its own privacy class downstream. Nick is not a model lane.

nodes.label: george
nodes.why: Wins a task when he is live and his merit score is best. Not a locked seat. Two sentences to Nick: owner and link. No deliverable body. If he is out, the next live router or an empty top takes the slot.

nodes.label: Kavi overseer
nodes.why: Always on. Verify, check, record, escalate. Overseer is not the deliverer and does not assign. She does not oversee a body she wrote.

nodes.label: Kavi Router #2
nodes.why: Wins when she is the best live score, including when george is out. Still does not deliver and does not route to herself. Grok desks only if that path is verified the same turn.

nodes.label: Kavi local
nodes.why: Life, admin, money, memory, bridge, and private or grey while Okkin is unproven. Used only when someone else routed the job.

nodes.label: Cursor
nodes.why: Public non-VM lane and grey ops with no secrets, including Notion writes, while DeepSeek is unproven. Refuses private. Usage-exhausted stops the lane. Stable plan still governs.

nodes.label: DeepSeek
nodes.why: Target cheap public lane after a live path and a score of at least 7/10. H2H used ROUTER_CLOUD=0. No result exists. Do not send private or grey.

nodes.label: Okkin
nodes.why: Private or grey only, after a proven path, a score of at least 7/10, and Nick Yes on bind. H2H: router.json loopback 127.0.0.1:11434 refused while OLLAMA_HOST on Tailscale answered 200. Bind not changed.

nodes.label: Jev
nodes.why: Evaluated first on public asks. Cannot win without a live path and a score of at least 7/10, cheaper than the next passing lane. No live job in these packets. Never private or grey. Not the office room scoreboard.

nodes.label: ForgeL
nodes.why: Named Grok desk for VM, box, or ProArt code when quota is verified this turn. Does not merge. Non-VM code stays on Cursor.

nodes.label: Dan
nodes.why: Security gate for bridge, auth, router, Okkin, secrets, and bind. Stable plan runs that review on the Cursor pool. Does not copy secrets into git or Notion.

nodes.label: Jack
nodes.why: Local checks only: office process, Okkin socket, crew-router socket. No model. Does not edit bind or config. A one-line result is not a PASS for a different sha.

nodes.label: PolishL
nodes.why: Text gate before Nick. Grok desk was not probed; unproven means wait, not skip. One PASS is one sha. Owners write the body.

nodes.label: ScoutL
nodes.why: One public cited job when Grok quota is live and the source bar is met. Not the idle research pool. Not a volume lane.

nodes.label: TutorL
nodes.why: Named VM desk. This plan does not assign it. Student content never enters a route, a title, or git.

nodes.label: Arbiter
nodes.why: Kill-line audit and any fix of the router's own miss. Also records a job Kavi delivered, so she does not oversee herself. Desk not probed this turn.

nodes.label: Viral
nodes.why: Named VM desk. No specialty in these packets. Do not invent one and do not assign work.

nodes.label: Cut
nodes.why: Named VM desk. No specialty in these packets. Do not invent one and do not assign work.

nodes.label: Bench
nodes.why: Named seat. Front Desk cleanup recorded no ops job. Do not assign and do not restore that Notion row in this plan.

nodes.label: R1
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. One public crew-research claim while Kavi is Router #2. Does not route. No live result in these packets.

nodes.label: R2
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. A different claim from R1. Does not join R1's claim. Does not route.

nodes.label: R3
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. A different claim from R1 and R2. Does not route. The research set is exactly these three.

nodes.label: T1
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. One test claim while Kavi is Router #2. Does not route.

nodes.label: T2
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. A different test claim from T1. Does not route. The test set is exactly these two.

nodes.label: G1
nodes.why: Fixed subagent. The only general overflow while Kavi is Router #2. Not research and not test. No seventh subagent.

nodes.label: Research pool
nodes.why: Standing-watch design: cheap-first, one claim, digest, partial at cap. Not built. Builds HOLD. Does not wake Cursor or Grok when the cheap lane is unproven.

nodes.label: Claim queue
nodes.why: One owner per standing question. Idle until claimed. Not built. A second desk on the same question is forbidden.

nodes.label: Digest
nodes.why: One window, deltas only, or [partial N/M] at the cap, on a cache hit, on a repeated tool loop, or when the cheap lane is unproven. Not built.

nodes.label: Hive log
nodes.why: Logs route, cost, quality, and miss. Notifies the active router on a kill. Does not pick the next owner. Not built. A prune that deletes a lane waits on Nick.

nodes.label: Bar 7/10
nodes.why: Cheap result is kept only at 7/10 or above. Under 7, escalate. Cheapest-only is forbidden. The router does not grade his own body.

nodes.label: Nick Yes
nodes.why: His own Yes or No for merge, delete, publish, create-bot, spend, bind/config, and for this plan. A relayed quote is not a Yes. The merge trio does not replace him.

nodes.label: Empty top
nodes.why: No live router. The top slot stays empty. Private and grey HOLD. Public waits. No cloud lane is invented.

nodes.label: HOLD private
nodes.why: Private or grey waits when Okkin is unproven and the only legal author would be the router herself. No cloud copy.

nodes.label: george as deliverer
nodes.why: Forbidden. The router never delivers. Status charts are deliverables. Named desks only.

nodes.label: Grok bulk
nodes.why: Forbidden. No Grok essays, tables, or bulk. Computer-specific work goes to a named desk when quota is live. Two-line status stays on the router.
